name: ink-desk-video
description: The Ink Desk demo video: Remotion motion design, a Playwright capture of the real app, ElevenLabs narration through OpenRouter.

scripts.render: tsx prepare.mts && remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/inkdesk-demo.mp4 --props=out/props.json --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --enforce-audio-track
scripts.render:motion: tsx prepare.mts && remotion render src/index.ts Motion out/motion-draft.mp4 --props=out/props.json --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --enforce-audio-track
